activity.notes: Antonio López de Santa Anna repeatedly transferred or lost presidential authority to other officeholders. This is presidential interval 4 of 11, recorded separately because the intervening periods were genuine breaks in office. ATLAS keeps month granularity rather than inventing a disputed exact day where Mexican official chronologies differ by a few days.

sources.title: Gaceta Parlamentaria, año XXII, número 5221-VII — Cámara de Diputados
sources.citation_text: The Mexican Chamber of Deputies parliamentary chronology enumerates Antonio López de Santa Anna's eleven separate periods exercising the presidency. ATLAS preserves the discontinuities and records month-level boundaries where official chronologies differ by several days.
